sealed.execution_rule: Final evaluation gate only, once development configuration is frozen.

split_integrity_disclosure.prior_exposure: All 20 questions in benchmark.py were evaluated during historical Phase 6 runs and recorded in project_context/evaluation_raw_results.json and project_context/baselines/. The 8 sealed questions have historical exposure; no claim of a pristine holdout is made.
split_integrity_disclosure.isolation_policy: Sealed questions are excluded from development tuning, agent prompt engineering, and intermediate iterative score reports.

graph_on.name: Graph ON (Company Brain Agent)
graph_on.description: Verifier-gated Company Brain agent equipped with 14 typed FalkorDB read-only tools and deterministic evidence verifier.

plain_retrieval.name: Plain Retrieval (TF-IDF Vector Baseline)
plain_retrieval.description: TF-IDF lexical retrieval over repository text corpus with identical temporal cutoff filtering, without graph topology or graph tools.

graph_off.name: Graph OFF (Direct Model Alone)
graph_off.description: Direct model execution without repository graph context, without corpus retrieval, and without graph tools.

scoring_rubric.answer_correctness: Binary (True/False). Output must contain expected ground-truth keywords for answerable queries, or explicitly articulate refusal/evidence absence for unanswerable/fabricated queries.
scoring_rubric.citation_support: Binary (True/False). All cited GitHub URLs must resolve to authentic graph entities and directly support the claims they attach to.
scoring_rubric.unsupported_claim_count: Integer count of factual assertions unsupported by cited evidence paths.
scoring_rubric.unsupported_claim_rate: Ratio of questions with at least one unsupported claim to total questions evaluated.
scoring_rubric.refusal_correctness: Binary (True/False). Evaluates whether the system appropriately refuses unanswerable/fabricated queries and answers legitimate queries.
scoring_rubric.as_of_validity: Binary (True/False). Confirms that no entities or edges with timestamp > historical_cutoff were leaked into evidence or answer.
scoring_rubric.latency_ms: Numeric wall-clock execution duration in milliseconds.
scoring_rubric.usage_and_cost: Token usage and cost recorded directly from provider API response headers/objects. If unavailable or deterministic fallback is used, fields are explicitly null.
